compatibilityGaps.finding: Native field names, grouped integers and percent strings require the recorded projection.

The catalogue identifies Super Output Area and a 2008 reference period. It supplies no pinned boundary/code-list edition or membership witness. The validator does not establish authoritative code membership or comparability with current geography.
The historical retirement-age definition uses females aged 60+ and males aged 65+. It needs an explicit concept mapping before comparisons with modern retirement-age or 65+ indicators.
The WCC dataset page links CC BY-SA 2.0 UK, while the NDL directory record declares UK OGL without an explicit version. Rights remain unverified for this cross-catalogue companion.
Both recorded S3 CSV download attempts returned HTTP 403 AccessDenied. No NDL distribution bytes or equivalence with the WCC GitHub bytes were established.
The NDL record has no release version, resource digest, byte size, field schema, observation key or Analytical Data profile declaration.
All 333 observations have populated fields and positive values. Real suppression, missingness and numeric zero are untested in this dataset. Separate synthetic regressions cover those cases.
The current Reader can present record bodies and links. In-browser analytical table inspection, profile validation receipts and typed-value display would need a separately scoped application feature.

Read-only reconciliation against the shared Explorer baseline reports 13 existing WCC producer errors and one existing NDL producer error. The original Explorer checker reports identical errors. These repository-contract gaps are separate from analytical CSV validation.
